english.title: Fail to comply with notice prohibiting / restricting access at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to observe or comply with a notice prohibiting or restricting access to a part of Bristol Airport, namely (..SPECIFY THE AREA..)
